Class WinnerViewController

java.lang.Object
view.WinnerViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
SceneController, ViewController
public class WinnerViewController extends Object implements SceneController
Last screen of the GUI. Showed after the normal end or early end of the game. Shows the winner(s) and the ranking of all players with their scoring breakdown. If the leaderboard DB is available, it also shows a button to open the leaderboard overlay. It implements the SceneController interface to be able to be called by the SceneRouter when the game ends.

    • showWinners

      public void showWinners(List<PlayerDto> players, List<String> winners, EndGameScoringDto scoring)
      Description copied from interface: ViewController
      Called when the game ends normally after all rounds are completed. Displays the winner(s) alongside a detailed breakdown of the final points. By default, it delegates to ViewController.showWinners(List, List) if detailed scoring is not supported. Overridden by WinnerViewController to show full categorized score details.
      Specified by:
      showWinners in interface ViewController
      Parameters:
      players - the list of players in the game
      winners - the list of winner usernames
      scoring - the detailed scoring breakdown for all players
